_comment: ADR 0027 — input bundle: WASD with first-person variant. 8 rules total: 4 world-frame (active when world_clock.camera_mode != first_person_3d) + 4 camera-relative (active when camera_mode == first_person_3d). Per-game physics.json splices via {$include: '@lib.input_bundles.wasd_with_fp_variant.rules'}. Action declarations under `actions` are FOR DOCUMENTATION; per-game ui/input.json still authors its own action list (the canonical InputMap declarations).

actions.name: stop_x
actions._doc: Engine-injected when neither move_east nor move_west is held. Per-axis idle: zero only the x component. Lets W+A (NW) → release A → keep W behavior work correctly: stop_x zeros x (was -3 from A), move_north sets y=-3, result (0, -3) = pure north.

actions.name: stop_y
actions._doc: Engine-injected when neither move_north nor move_south is held. Same per-axis idle pattern.

actions.name: stop
actions._doc: LEGACY full-idle stop. Engine-injected when no movement key is held AND stop_action_on_idle='stop'. New games should use stop_x + stop_y (per-axis); kept for backwards-compat.

rules._comment: World-frame WASD — fires when camera is NOT first_person_3d. W=north regardless of player facing. Spliced into game's physics.json rules array. Per-axis pattern (added 2026-05-10): each directional rule sets ONLY its own axis. Engine's velocity_set preserves the OTHER axis when the field is omitted, so W+D = north + east diagonal works (each rule contributes one axis; combined velocity is (3, -3) at 45°). With both axes set per rule, last-writer-wins broke diagonals.

STOP_X — engine queues stop_x when neither move_east nor move_west is held (per-axis idle, world.gd::_poll_input). Zeros only the x component — preserves y so a still-held W/S keeps working. Empirical bug 2026-05-10: releasing one of two held movement keys, player kept drifting in the released direction.
STOP_Y — mirror of STOP_X for the y axis (north/south).

LEGACY full-idle STOP — fires when no movement key is held AND stop_action_on_idle='stop'. New games should rely on stop_x + stop_y (per-axis). Kept for backwards-compat with games that haven't migrated.

Camera-relative WASD — fires when camera IS first_person_3d. Engine's velocity_add_relative reads actor.state.facing (mouse-driven by _camera_first_person_3d's _drain_mouse_facing) and rotates forward/strafe into world XZ, then ADDS to current velocity. W=mouse-aim-forward, S=back, A=strafe-left, D=strafe-right. velocity_add (not _set) lets W+D combine into a forward-right diagonal in same tick. Drag in motion integrator decelerates when no key held — but stop rule below explicitly zeros to avoid drift.

ADR 0040 — Camera-relative WASD for isometric_3d. Player presses W → moves where the camera is 'looking forward' (NW in world for SE-camera-looking-NW). facing=π/4 = 45° rotates the (forward, strafe) basis to align with the camera's XZ projection. Uses velocity_add_relative + per-tick zero (state.zero_velocity_pretick=true on the actor) so W+D both held → contributions sum to world-N (pure -Z) → projects to screen-up-right. Speed clamp via state.max_speed normalizes the diagonal sum to walking speed.
